title: 胶片日常·旅行
prompt: Transform this everyday snapshot into a candid analog film photograph. Keep the person's face, expression, hairstyle and outfit exactly unchanged. Late-afternoon warm backlight, Kodak Portra-like color response, fine film grain, off-center framing, no orange wash, no plastic skin.
negative_prompt: orange color wash, fake light leaks, plastic smooth skin, changed facial features, watermark, text
